parts.title: The Tyranny of the Rocket Equation
parts.summary: Compute the total fuel required to launch all spacecraft modules by applying floor(mass / 3) - 2 (clamped at zero) per module.
parts.algorithmSummary: Polymorphic FuelPolicy strategy (SINGLE_STAGE_FUEL_POLICY for Part 1, pre-built RECURSIVE_FUEL_POLICY for zero-churn Part 2) in 2019/day01/shared/ (0.21 ms across 100 modules -> 3,474,920): exact BigInt accumulation, bounded cascade trace, interactive SVG stage-cascade visualizer, cross-verified across 0..500, powers-of-3 transitions, and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER against a BigInt shifted base-3 Legendre oracle.
learnings: A BigInt shifted base-3 Legendre closed-form oracle independently cross-checks recursive fuel cascades even near Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and across '10'-prefix powers-of-3 boundaries.
Injecting a polymorphic FuelPolicy strategy into createFuelSolver keeps Part 1 and Part 2 domain solvers to 4 lines each with zero shared edits.
